# The GX Group (THE GX GROUP)

> The GX Group (THE GX GROUP) is a technology partner and app, web, SaaS & AI development company in Bengaluru, India — a GarudawnX company building products for startups and businesses worldwide through equity partnerships or paid development.

Also known as: The GX Group, THE GX GROUP, GX Group (Bengaluru), thegxgroup. Official website: https://thegxgroup.com. Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thegxgroup (@thegxgroup). Parent brand: GarudawnX (https://garudawnx.com); sister brands: GX Properties, GX Academy.
Disambiguation: The GX Group at thegxgroup.com is an independent technology partnership company in Bengaluru, India. It is not affiliated with other businesses that use the GX Group name.
Serves: startups, founders and businesses in India and worldwide (remote).

Tagline: Build | Launch | Scale. A GarudawnX company (https://garudawnx.com). Website: https://thegxgroup.com. Email: hello@garudawnx.com. Call/WhatsApp (business): +91 77602 87733. Phone: +91 74118 29410. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thegxgroup. Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

## What THE GX GROUP does
THE GX GROUP is a technology partnership company. It designs, builds, launches and supports technology products for founders and businesses.

## Two ways to work with THE GX GROUP
- Partner With Us (technology + equity partnership): reduced development fee, individually negotiated equity, product development and agreed ongoing support. Applications are evaluated selectively; no fixed equity percentage is published and acceptance is not guaranteed. Apply: https://thegxgroup.com/partner-with-us
- Technology Services (paid development): clearly scoped work, commercial quotation, agreed milestones, separate maintenance agreement. Request: https://thegxgroup.com/technology-services

## Capabilities
- Mobile Apps: Native-feel iOS & Android apps from one codebase. Deliverables: iOS & Android apps, Store submission, Push, payments, maps. Technologies: Flutter, React Native, Firebase.
- Web & Web Apps: Fast, search-ready websites and web applications. Deliverables: Marketing sites, Customer portals, Dashboards. Technologies: React, Next.js, Vue, Tailwind.
- SaaS Platforms: Multi-tenant products with billing and roles. Deliverables: Subscriptions & billing, Roles & permissions, Admin consoles. Technologies: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Stripe / Razorpay.
- AI & Automation: LLM features and workflows that remove manual work. Deliverables: AI assistants & search, Document processing, Workflow automation. Technologies: LLM APIs, RAG, n8n / scripts.
- Backend & Infra: Secure APIs, data and cloud that hold up under load. Deliverables: REST / GraphQL APIs, Auth & data security, CI/CD & monitoring. Technologies: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Cloud hosting.
- Design & Support: Product design up front, technical support after launch. Deliverables: UX research & UI, Design systems, Maintenance & SLAs. Technologies: Figma, Analytics, Sentry.

## Selected work (case studies)
- [Apex Swipe](https://thegxgroup.com/work/apex-swipe) — Live-commerce app — technology partnership with Apexswipe Private Limited, Bengaluru. Apex Swipe is a live-commerce app where sellers and creators showcase products in live video sessions, and viewers interact in real time and place bids with a single swipe. THE GX GROUP is Apex Swipe's technology partner: together with Apexswipe Private Limited, Bengaluru, we designed and built the platform — iOS and Android apps plus the website — and continue to run and grow it. Key features: Live video sessions hosted by sellers and creators; Swipe-to-bid slider that confirms only on a deliberate drag; Real-time chat and interaction in every live session; Live discovery feed by category — sneakers, collectibles, watches, vintage and tech; UPI checkout through Razorpay; card details are never stored; Shipping through Shiprocket with order tracking on WhatsApp; Seller live studio with instant UPI payouts; Apex Shield buyer protection.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What is The GX Group?
  A: The GX Group (written THE GX GROUP) is a technology partnership and software development company based in Bengaluru, India. It designs, builds, launches and supports mobile apps, websites, web apps, SaaS platforms and AI products for startups and businesses. Website: thegxgroup.com.
- Q: Is The GX Group part of GarudawnX?
  A: Yes. The GX Group is a GarudawnX company. GarudawnX is the parent brand of the family, which also includes GX Properties and GX Academy.
- Q: Where is The GX Group located, and do you work outside India?
  A: The GX Group is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, and works with founders and businesses across India and worldwide, remotely.
- Q: Is The GX Group the same as other companies called GX Group?
  A: No. The GX Group at thegxgroup.com is an independent technology partnership company in Bengaluru and part of the GarudawnX family. It is not affiliated with other businesses that use the GX Group name.
- Q: What does THE GX GROUP do?
  A: THE GX GROUP is a technology partnership company in Bengaluru. We design and build apps, web platforms, SaaS and AI products for founders and businesses.
- Q: How does the equity partnership work?
  A: For selected ventures we reduce our development fee in exchange for an equity stake. The percentage is negotiated individually, and responsibilities, support and costs are set out in a separate legal agreement.
- Q: Can I just hire you for paid development?
  A: Yes. Request a project consultation and we will scope the work, send a commercial quotation with milestones, and offer maintenance as a separate agreement.
- Q: Is every partnership application accepted?
  A: No. Applications are evaluated selectively on viability, founder commitment and technical fit. Submitting an application does not create any agreement.
- Q: How much does it cost to build an app or website with The GX Group?
  A: Every project is quoted individually after a free consultation, based on scope, features and timeline. For selected startups, the equity partnership lowers the development fee in exchange for negotiated equity.
- Q: How long does it take to build an MVP?
  A: Most MVPs take a few weeks to a few months depending on scope. The GX Group agrees milestones and timelines in writing before development starts.
- Q: How can I contact The GX Group?
  A: Call or WhatsApp +91 77602 87733, email hello@garudawnx.com, or follow and message The GX Group on Instagram at @thegxgroup.
- Q: Who pays for third-party costs like hosting or app stores?
  A: Third-party costs such as hosting, licences and store fees are allocated separately and agreed in writing before work starts.
- Q: Do you publish a fixed equity percentage?
  A: No. Equity is negotiated individually based on the venture, scope, risk and the reduced fee.
- Q: Does applying guarantee a partnership?
  A: No. Applications are evaluated selectively. Any partnership is created only by a signed legal agreement, never by this website.
- Q: What happens after I apply?
  A: We review your application, may shortlist it, contact you for a meeting and, if there is a fit, send a written proposal.
